title: DEVELOPER FOR 3D/XR
meta: Salary aligned with the market + typical French benefits (Health Insurance, 50% Transportation card)
html:
Wetin di work be

Di pesin wey we go pick go dey in charge of:

  • Design and build real-time 3D and XR apps plus di main parts wey hold dem
  • Build XR experience and make am sharp well-well for visionOS and platforms wey follow OpenXR standard
  • Set up and maintain rendering pipelines wey get strict rule for performance and latency
  • Work wit spatial tracking, world mapping, hand tracking and di sensors wey dey inside device
  • Make frame rate, memory and di power wey XR devices dey use better
  • Join 3D engines, native SDK and di API wey belong to each platform togeda
  • Find and fix wahala wey tough for rendering, synchronization and spatial alignment
  • Work hand-in-hand wit designers, product teams and systems engineers
  • Get mouth for architecture decisions and long-term XR tech strategy
  • Write correct technical documentation and review code like senior pesin

Di tech skills wey you must get

  • Strong foundation for real-time 3D maths (linear algebra, transforms, projections)
  • Solid experience for building Augmented Reality / XR apps
  • Sabi visionOS well-well plus how im spatial computing dey work
  • Hands-on experience wit OpenXR (runtime integration, extensions, abstraction across different devices)
  • Understand rendering concepts deep-deep (render loops, shaders, GPU/CPU synchronization)
  • Experience to work under real-time pressure (frame budget, latency, motion-to-photon)
  • Programming languages: C++ / Swift / Objective-C (for visionOS and Apple platforms) / C# (Unity or engine-level tools) / Rust (for components wey performance matter pass or for engine level, e go add beta point for you)
  • Frameworks: visionOS SDK, OpenXR, Unity, Unreal Engine or in-house engines wey company build by demsef, Metal, Vulkan or DirectX, AR frameworks (ARKit or oda spatial tracking systems wey be like am)

Who you be

  • 5 to 10 years experience for software development work, wit big focus for 3DXR systems programming
  • Proof say you don work for systems wey tough and wey important well-well
  • Strong 3DXR thinking and di power to understand big codebase wey don dey before you come
  • You dey careful, you fit work on your own, you dey see small details, and you like to solve tech wahala wey no easy
  • Skills wey go add sweet: Experience wit mixed reality or spatial UI design
  • Skills wey go add sweet: Contribution to open-source projects for 3D, XR or graphics

How di interview go waka

  1. Call of 15 minutes to know you — Quick gist about wetin dey motivate you, whether you go fit join us well, and we go answer your questions wey no be tech.
  2. Two tech/product interviews, one hour each — We go dig deep inside how you dey take solve problem, wit our CTO and/or our lead solution architect
  3. Meet di team, make una greet — Relax session make we see say our culture match.

Wetin we go give you

  • Work for XR and spatial computing technology wey dey front-front
  • You go own real-time systems wey tough for tech side
  • Projects wey heavy for tech and wey go challenge your brain
  • Place wey respect true engineering sabi and wey focus on tech (no yeye meetings or reports)
  • Full freedom to take tech decisions
